title: Flight deck
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one exceptionally polished, highly functional desktop application UI design concept, landscape 16:10 1920x1200 style. This is BSGO Mining Cockpit, a real local manual-assist mining dashboard for a space MMO, NOT a fictional movie HUD. Render flat front-on pixel-crisp interface design, beautiful typography with real readable labels, generous spacing, restrained industrial aesthetic, no perspective device, no walls of microtext, no gratuitous rings, no invented radar or nearby target list. Large authentic-looking game feed shows a spaceship in a dark asteroid field with compact red-orange in-game HUD inside the feed ONLY. App chrome is calmer and more legible than game. Operational facts to preserve: Manual mode, Input: Human, Autopilot unavailable, fresh feed 0.4 s, current image 2560 × 1440, selected asteroid range 1,579 m, speed 0 m/s, hull 5,005 / 5,005, energy 733 / 800, Target health: Unknown. Routine choices Scan once, Auto-scan selected, Approach; choosing is distinct from starting. Approach is selected. Actions paused, with explicit short reason. Show assessment checkboxes Clear corridor, Aligned heading, Safe stopped scene, Flight point, then separate Start approach button. Persistent Pause actions and Cancel routine locations. Easy to access Diagnostics, History, Settings. Clearly state CONCEPT · SAMPLE DATA. Typography minimum readable 14px-equivalent body; prioritize game image, task state, range, speed, actionable readiness over decoration.
Direction 1 FLIGHT DECK. Dark graphite and midnight-blue with pale cyan action accent, pale off-white readable labels. Broad main feed on left 65%, fixed 360px operations rail on right. Compact header and status strip, range and speed grouped above feed as four horizontal metrics, compact hull/energy below feed. Right rail has selected task, clear state explanation, assessment and strong action area; muted red cancel beside start, global pause top right. Understated squared 8px corners and 1px borders. Aerospace precision meets excellent modern developer tool. Tiny title '01 / FLIGHT DECK'.
